name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key, drawn in pencil as a little keycap with a shaded thickness that presses flat under your finger. Used inline, in groups, in tooltips and in menus.

a11y: Kbd is the semantic <kbd> element: screen readers read the text as it is written. Write words for modifier keys when the symbol would be read unhelpfully ("Ctrl" rather than an icon), or give an icon-only key an Icon with a label (aria-label is not allowed on a bare <kbd>).
Decorative by nature: it is not focusable and has no role. The press animation is pointer feedback only; nothing depends on it.
Muted graphite on paper is 8.9:1. Inside a Tooltip or a menu the label and the drawing take that surface's text color.
Calm density draws a plain pencil box without the thickness; reduced motion removes the press transition.
